risks: Do not delete financial, order, campaign, wallet, ledger, audit, analytics, session, or config data without archival and owner approval.

rollbackPlan: Export BSON with mongodump before any cleanup.
Export JSON for human-readable verification of target collections.
Save index definitions from this report before any index migration.
